problemStatement.formal: Formalize representative applications of the probabilistic method, including Ramsey lower bounds, tournament domination, crossing-number estimates, unbalancing lights, and Property B lower bounds.
problemStatement.plain: Apply the probabilistic method library to a small suite of classical combinatorics results: existence-style Ramsey, tournament, graph drawing, switching, and hypergraph coloring bounds.
whyMatters: Shows that the probability infrastructure is useful for standard extremal-combinatorics arguments rather than only toy examples.
Gives compact verified examples of the first-moment and random-construction style used throughout probabilistic combinatorics.

proven: `ramsey_lower_bound` proves a diagonal Ramsey lower-bound application.
`tournament_domination` proves an existence result for small dominating sets in tournaments.
`crossing_number_bound` packages a crossing-number style lower-bound application.
`property_b_lower` proves a lower-bound application for Property B.
knownResults.goal: Keep the examples as a verified application gallery for the probabilistic-method library.

currentState.focus: Integration testing for the full probabilistic method library.
blockers: Blocked until probabilistic method library (expectation, alteration, second moment, LLL) is substantially complete.
currentState.nextAction: Wait for library foundations, then apply to classical results.
